summary: Product leader with verified experience delivering customer-facing platforms across distributed engineering teams. Known for translating ambiguous customer problems into prioritized roadmaps, aligning cross-functional stakeholders, and shipping measurable improvements to adoption and retention across multiple product lines and regional markets.
